$description: Shadowrunr OS design tokens: the ONE source. Primitives are raw values copied byte-equal from the winning prototype (The Poster Wall: poster.css, l1.css, l2.css, app.js PAGES/SA, sr-kit.js RANK_COLORS/GRADE_COLORS). Roles name an intent and resolve to exactly one primitive. Regenerate with `node packages/tokens/scripts/generate.mjs`; candidates that failed admission are listed in REJECTED.md.
